text.id: Magrib lagi dari tiga masjid. Crane-crane reklamasi udah nyalain lampu merahnya, satu-satu, kayak mata.
text.en: The call to prayer again, from three mosques. The reclamation cranes have switched on their red lights, one by one, like eyes.

text.id: Telepon semalem. Lo bilang ada bunyi klik dua kali. Itu apa?
text.en: Last night's call. You said there were two clicks. What were they?

text.id: Waktu gue masih jadi editornya, kita rekaman di tempat-tempat berisik. Pasar, dermaga, demo. Nggak bisa ngomong, nggak bisa teriak.
text.en: Back when I was still her editor, we recorded in loud places. Markets, piers, protests. You couldn't talk, couldn't shout.

text.id: Jadi kita bikin kode. Klik tombol rekam sekali artinya "tunggu". Dua kali artinya "gue aman, lanjut rekam".
text.en: So we made up a code. One click of the record button meant "wait". Two clicks meant "I'm okay, keep rolling".

text.id: Dia aman.
text.en: She's okay.

text.id: Dia pake kode yang cuma gue yang ngerti. Setahun gue nggak ngomong sama dia, dan dia masih pake kode kita.
text.en: She used a code only I would understand. A year I didn't speak to her, and she still used our code.

text.id: Dinda nangis tanpa suara, mukanya ditutupin lengan sweater Sekar. Gue biarin. Gue juga.
text.en: Dinda cries without a sound, her face hidden in the sleeve of Sekar's sweater. I let her. I do too.

text.id: Oke. Kita punya dua jalan.
text.en: Okay. We have two ways in.

text.id: Satu, dermaga. Pak Hendra tahu sesuatu. Kapalnya, telepon tanpa suara itu, ombak sama genset.
text.en: One, the pier. Pak Hendra knows something. His boat, that silent call, the waves and the generator.

text.id: Dua, orang-orangnya. Tasya ditelepon orang PT. Bima ngomong sesuatu ke bosnya. Didit dapet nomor HP ini dari Bima. Ada yang nyambung di situ.
text.en: Two, the people. Tasya got a call from the company. Bima said something to his boss. Didit got this phone's number from Bima. Something connects there.

text.id: Kita bisa dua-duanya.
text.en: We could do both.

text.id: Didit tahu semester gue, Ka. Kita nggak punya waktu buat dua-duanya.
text.en: Didit knows what semester I'm in, Ka. We don't have time for both.

text.id: Ke mana dulu?
text.en: Where first?

text.id: Ke dermaga. Cari Pak Hendra lagi.
text.en: The pier. Find Pak Hendra again.

text.id: Ke orang-orangnya. Tasya dan Bima.
text.en: The people. Tasya and Bima.

text.id: Dermaga. Kalau Kak Sekar ketemu narsumnya di laut, jawabannya ada di laut.
text.en: The pier. If Sekar met her source at sea, the answer is at sea.

text.id: Dia bilang "jaga adiknya". Dia nggak bakal bilang gitu kalau dia nggak peduli.
text.en: He said "look after her sister". He wouldn't say that if he didn't care.

text.id: Dia nutup pintu waktu itu. Kali ini gue harus ngetok dengan cara yang bener.
text.en: He shut me out last time. This time I have to knock the right way.

text.id: Orang-orangnya. Tasya bukan jahat, Bima bukan jahat. Tapi salah satu dari mereka yang bikin Didit tahu.
text.en: The people. Tasya isn't bad, Bima isn't bad. But one of them is how Didit found out.

text.id: Dan orang yang ngerasa bersalah biasanya pengen ngaku. Mereka cuma butuh orang yang mau dengerin.
text.en: And people who feel guilty usually want to confess. They just need someone who'll listen.

text.id: Kita duduk di dak sampai gelap. Dinda nyenderin kepalanya ke bahu gue, cuma sebentar, kayak lupa.
text.en: We sit on the roof until it's dark. Dinda leans her head on my shoulder, just for a moment, like she forgot not to.
